openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:title: renewSSO() Simulation Mode
openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:summary: Simulates different renewSSO() host behaviors to exercise the SDK's 403 recovery and SSO renewal paths

openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:title: Expire Auth Token Only
openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:summary: Replaces the stored auth token with an expired one and leaves the refresh token valid, so the next request 403s and recovers via the refresh-token path alone

openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:title: Expire Auth + Refresh Tokens
openweb.sample.ui.screens.settings.prefe.app:summary: Replaces both stored tokens with expired ones, so the next request 403s and recovery falls through to SSO renewal
